name: fme-pipeline
description: Generate Harness pipelines with FeatureFlag or Custom stages for flag rollout scenarios: progressive ramp, multi-env promotion, beta cohorts, config promotion, bootstrap, retirement, segment sync, test targeting. Composes FmeFlag* steps with optional HarnessApproval/Wait/Jira/ServiceNow/metric gates. Use when asked to build a flag rollout pipeline, promote flags across environments, or automate flag lifecycle. Do not use for direct flag operations (update-flag-targeting) or general CI/CD (create-pipeline). Related: create-trigger (automate), run-pipeline (execute). Trigger phrases: FME pipeline, feature flag pipeline, flag rollout pipeline, progressive rollout, multi-environment promotion, flag bootstrap.
